Direction No. 65
CONSUMER AFFAIRS AUTHORITY ACT, No. 09 OF 2003
Direction under Section 12(2)

ACTING under the powers vested in it by Section 12(2) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003, theConsumer Affairs Authority directs that no Manufacturer, Importer, Packer, Distributor or Trader shall manufacture,import, distribute, pack, store or sell or display for sale, expose for sale, or offer for sale, wholesale or retail any skincreams and lotions unless such skin creams and lotions shall conform to the permissible maximum limits for heavymetals when tested in accordance with ISO/TR 17276 as specified in SLS 743 issued by the Sri Lanka Standard Institution.
Heavy MetalPermissible MaximumLimit
Lead (as Pb)10 mg/kg
Arsenic (as As)3 mg/kg
Mercury (as Hg)1 mg/kg
Cadmium (as Cd)3 mg/kg
Skin Creams and Lotions include ;
(1) makeup creams and lotions(2) cleansing creams and lotions(3) moisturizing creams and lotions(4) hair removal creams and lotions(5) sun screen creams and lotions

Colombo,01st May 2018.
Direction No. 66
CONSUMER AFFAIRS AUTHORITY ACT, No. 09 OF 2003
Direction under Section 10(1)(a)

ACTING undet the powers vested in it by Section 10(1)(a) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003, theConsumer Affairs Authority directs all Manufacturers, Importers, Packers, Distributors or Traders of skin creams andlotions that the following information shall be legibly and indelibly marked on each and every bottle, pack or container ofskin creams and lotion. However, a separate leaflet containing such information may be issued for skin creams and lotionsof pack sizes of 50g/50ml or less.

(1) Name of the Product(2) Name and address of the Manufacturer(3) Name and address of the importer and/or distributor in Sri Lanka(4) Country of Manufacture(5) Brand name(6) Volume/weight(7) Batch or code or lot identification number(8) Date of manufacture(9) Expiry date or Best before date(10) Maximum Retail Price(11) List of Ingredients(12) Instructions for use(13) Warning statements, if any
Skin creams and lotions include ;
(1) makeup creams and lotions(2) cleansing creams and lotions(3) moisturizing creams and lotions(4) hair removal cream and lotions(5) sun screen creams and lotions
